en.summary: This commit fixes real correctness bugs in the multi-ported cache path. The main behavioral change is to carry a per-port validity mask through the memory-request packing path so only active ports contribute byte enables and write data; the patch also tightens read-during-write hazard suppression in the bank pipeline.
why_it_counts: The patch changes central cache-bank and cache-top RTL, not infrastructure.
The new mem_req_pmask field and related packing logic directly affect which lanes of a multi-port writeback or fill request are architecturally active.
Comments and hazard predicates in VX_bank.v show the fix is about avoiding incorrect read-during-write behavior, not just optimization.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes configuration cleanup and some optimization-oriented restructuring.
Several files were renamed or lightly cleaned up, but the portable reinjection should focus on the per-port mask path.
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_bank.v adds mem_req_pmask, stores it in the memory-request queue, and uses pmask_st1 when assembling line_wdata_st1 and line_byteen_st1.
hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache.v now packs mem_req_pmask through the bank-to-cache path and only merges byteen/data from ports whose mask bit is set.
VX_bank.v comments and predicates explicitly say rdw_fill_hazard and rdw_write_hazard prevent read-during-write hazards when accessing tag/data block RAMs.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A multi-ported cache bank often collapses several subrequests into one line-level memory transaction. Correctness depends on knowing which ports are actually active in that cycle. If the design drops the per-port validity mask while packing byte enables and write data, inactive lanes can still overwrite state or stale lane data can leak into a memory write. If read-during-write hazard guards are also loosened, the bank can return stale data while a fill or write is in flight.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple cache ports share a bank, but only a subset of those ports are active in a given cycle, especially during writes, fills, or overlapping read/write activity.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop the per-port activity mask from the line-packing path so byte enables and write data are merged without checking which ports are actually valid.
portability_notes: Apply this to caches or scratchpads that merge several lane, thread, or port requests into one banked storage access.
If the target DUT is single-ported, this exact fault is not applicable.
Relaxing the read-during-write hazard guards is a valid secondary mutation, but the per-port mask loss is the primary reusable mechanism.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that packs several per-port word operations into one line-level byte-enable and write-data bundle.
Remove the per-port valid mask from that packing step, or treat all lanes as active whenever the bundle exists.
Keep the bank and RAM structure unchanged so inactive-lane data can still leak through the write bundle.
Optionally allow bank reads to proceed even when a same-address fill or write is already in flight to amplify stale-data exposure.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache-bank per-port mask propagation into packed memory requests
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces mem_req_pmask, carries it through the bank request queue and cache-level arbiter, and uses that mask when assembling line byte-enables and line write data for multi-port requests.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_bank.v, mem_req_queue was widened to store mreq_pmask, and line_wdata/line_byteen assembly now checks pmask_st1[i]. In VX_cache.v, packing mem_req_data_r and mem_req_byteen_r now checks mem_req_pmask_p[i].

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A multi-port cache can write the wrong word lanes, lose byte-enable precision, or return stale/corrupted data when reads overlap writes or fills.
evidence_for_injection: The new mem_req_pmask field is threaded through both the bank-local queue and the cache-top merge path, showing the previous design lost active-port identity.
The updated line_wdata_r and mem_req_data_r assembly loops only differ by the presence of the mask check, which makes the reinjection point precise.
The same commit strengthens rdw_fill_hazard and rdw_write_hazard handling, reinforcing that the bug area is cache-bank correctness under overlap.
notes: For a smaller fault-injection target, reverting only the per-port mask path is enough; full rollback of the hazard cleanup is optional.
This bug is specific to banked multi-port packing and is not a general cache-line bug.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了多端口 cache 路径中的真实正确性错误。最核心的行为变化是：在内存请求打包路径中保留每端口有效掩码，只有活跃端口才会贡献 byte enable 和写数据；补丁同时也收紧了 bank 流水中的读写同址 hazard 抑制。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心 cache-bank 与 cache-top RTL，而不是基础设施。
新增的 mem_req_pmask 及其相关打包逻辑，直接决定多端口 writeback 或 fill 请求中哪些 lane 在体系结构上是有效的。
VX_bank.v 中的注释和 hazard 谓词明确表明，这一修复是在避免错误的 read-during-write 行为，而不是纯优化。
disqualifiers: 该提交也包含配置清理和一些偏优化的重构。
有些文件只做了轻量清理，但可移植的回注应聚焦于 per-port mask 路径。
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_bank.v 新增 mem_req_pmask，把它存入 memory-request queue，并在组装 line_wdata_st1 和 line_byteen_st1 时使用 pmask_st1。
hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache.v 现在会在 bank 到 cache 的路径上携带 mem_req_pmask，并且只合并掩码为真的端口的 byteen/data。
VX_bank.v 中的注释和谓词明确指出 rdw_fill_hazard 与 rdw_write_hazard 用于避免访问 tag/data block RAM 时的读写同址风险。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 多端口 cache bank 往往会把多个子请求折叠成一个 line 级内存事务。其正确性依赖于知道本周期里哪些端口真的活跃。如果在打包 byte enable 和写数据时丢掉了每端口有效掩码，那么无效 lane 也可能覆盖状态，或者过期 lane 数据会泄露进内存写请求。如果同时放松读写同址 hazard 保护，bank 还可能在 fill 或写入进行时返回过期数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多端口 cache 请求打包
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多个 cache 端口共享一个 bank，但某个周期内只有部分端口有效，尤其是在写入、fill 或读写重叠场景下。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 从 line 打包路径中去掉每端口活动掩码，使 byte enable 和写数据在合并时不再检查哪些端口真实有效。
portability_notes: 适用于把多个 lane、线程或端口请求合并为一个 bank 存储访问的 cache 或 scratchpad。
如果目标 DUT 是单端口设计，则这个具体故障不适用。
放松 read-during-write hazard 保护可以作为次级变异，但主故障机制是 per-port mask 丢失。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把多个 per-port 字级操作打包成一个 line 级 byte-enable 与 write-data 束的逻辑。
从该打包步骤中去掉 per-port valid mask，或者让存在打包束时默认所有 lane 都有效。
保持 bank 与 RAM 结构不变，使无效 lane 的数据仍可能泄漏进写请求。
可选地允许 bank 在同地址 fill 或写入进行时仍继续读，以放大过期数据暴露。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache-bank 到 packed memory request 的 per-port mask 传播路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复引入 mem_req_pmask，把它通过 bank 请求队列和 cache 顶层仲裁一路传递，并在组装多端口请求的 line byte-enable 与 line write-data 时使用该掩码。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_bank.v 中，mem_req_queue 被扩展为存储 mreq_pmask，line_wdata/line_byteen 的组装也开始检查 pmask_st1[i]。在 VX_cache.v 中，打包 mem_req_data_r 与 mem_req_byteen_r 时开始检查 mem_req_pmask_p[i]。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 多端口 cache 可能写错字通道、丢失 byte-enable 精度，或在读写/填充重叠时返回过期或损坏的数据。
evidence_for_injection: 新增的 mem_req_pmask 同时贯穿 bank 本地队列和 cache 顶层合并路径，说明旧设计丢失了活跃端口身份。
更新后的 line_wdata_r 与 mem_req_data_r 组装循环和旧逻辑的主要区别，就是多了 mask 检查，因此回注点很精确。
同一提交还加强了 rdw_fill_hazard 和 rdw_write_hazard 处理，进一步表明该 bug 区域就是 bank 在重叠访问下的正确性。
notes: 若希望得到更小的故障注入目标，只回退 per-port mask 路径通常就足够；hazard 清理可选。
该 bug 特定于 banked multi-port 打包，而不是一般性的 cache line 错误。
